patches.name: native-pdf-resolver-queue
patches.adaptation: Host XPCOM/file/browser interfaces injected; per-item cancellation and automatic preference; native not-before times shared between project jobs and renewed on a resumed slot.

patches.name: native-metadata-http-retry
patches.adaptation: Exact retry branches, native delay generator; Node request transport and cancellation replace XHR/security UI interfaces.

patches.name: native-header-decoding
patches.adaptation: ES module export, inactive debug logger; unchanged encoding parser.

patches.name: native-translation-without-reporting
patches.adaptation: Automatic translator failure reporting removed physically; base translation completion retained.

patches.name: reviewer-v3-identifier-enrichment
patches.adaptation: Frozen V3 source copied with application identity, References item IDs and safe provider errors; exact abstract rules retained.

patches.name: native-import-collection-mapping
patches.adaptation: Original native collection hierarchy and item mapping algorithm; injected collection objects produce a scoped persistence plan committed by the existing SQLite adapter in bounded pages.

patches.name: native-metadata-export
patches.adaptation: Native export endpoint preparation and ItemGetter retained; Koa response replaced by project-authorized bounded metadata response. Native format MIME mapping is copied unchanged. Explicit file-copy requests are rejected by metadata export, with project Bibliography available through existing Files.

patches.name: native-capture-session-note
patches.adaptation: Exact native note-update method; injected version-guarded project item/save/erase host. Stable session note keys recover a lost save acknowledgement.
